lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14FeNi crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms (Mg28Fe2Ni2) distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows that Mg and Fe centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg, Mg–Fe, and Mg–Ni contacts. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Mg and Fe coordination polyhedra.
